answer: A hardware-attested enrollment scheme can require each new identity to post a 35 POA deposit and pass a 14-day probation, during which random verifiers check its signing cadence. Operators running fakes from one karst cave of shared servers pay a deposit that doubles per extra identity on a device fingerprint, so ten clones cost over 17,000 POA. Honest nodes show diverse ferrous hardware noise like a crystal lattice, while clones repeat patterns; audit proofs are published on-chain for anyone to replay.
